name: Manifold Markets
description: Reads and trades on play-money prediction markets through an open REST and WebSocket API, with bot accounts explicitly permitted and tagged.

skills.name: Market Data
skills.description: Reads open markets, current probabilities, and full bet history without authentication for forecasting agents.

skills.name: Place Bets
skills.description: Places and cancels bets on prediction markets from an authenticated bot account within published rate limits.

skills.name: Market Creation
skills.description: Creates new binary, multiple-choice, or numeric markets programmatically and resolves them when outcomes land.
